top_news.headline: Bank Indonesia holds BI-Rate at 5.75%; rupiah firms to 17,875/USD
top_news.headline_original: BI Tahan Suku Bunga, Rupiah Justru Menguat Tipis ke Rp17.875/US$
top_news.summary: Bank Indonesia kept its policy rate unchanged at 5.75%, and the rupiah strengthened slightly to Rp17,875 per US dollar.

top_news.headline: IHSG snaps nine-day winning streak as foreign investors turn net sellers
top_news.headline_original: IHSG Turun Hari Ini (22/7), Menyetop Reli 9 Hari Diiringi Net Sell Asing
top_news.summary: The Jakarta Composite Index fell, ending a nine-session rally, accompanied by net foreign selling.

top_news.headline: Foreign funds pour US$8.5 billion into Indonesia
top_news.headline_original: Investor Berbondong-bondong ke RI, Dana Asing Masuk US$ 8,5 M ke RI
top_news.summary: CNBC Indonesia reports foreign investors channeled about US$8.5 billion into Indonesian assets.

top_news.headline: BEI flags 59 issuers at risk of forced delisting, including two SOEs
top_news.headline_original: BEI Umumkan 59 Emiten Berpotensi Delisting Paksa, Dua BUMN Masuk Daftar
top_news.summary: The Indonesia Stock Exchange named 59 listed companies that could face forced delisting, two of them state-owned.

top_news.headline: BI to safeguard liquidity via repo and Rp188.68 trillion of bond purchases
top_news.headline_original: Jaga Likuiditas, BI Andalkan Repo dan Beli SBN Rp188,68 T
top_news.summary: Bank Indonesia said it will rely on repo operations and buy Rp188.68 trillion of government securities to maintain liquidity.

top_news.headline: Bank lending growth accelerates to 12.67% in June
top_news.headline_original: Lebih Laju, Kredit Perbankan Juni Tumbuh 12,67%
top_news.summary: Indonesian banking credit grew 12.67% year-on-year in June, a faster pace than the prior month.

top_news.headline: Alexander Ramlie buys 1.47 million Amman Mineral (AMMN) shares
top_news.headline_original: Alexander Ramlie Borong 1,47 Juta Saham Amman Mineral (AMMN)
top_news.summary: Alexander Ramlie purchased 1.47 million shares of Amman Mineral Internasional (AMMN).

top_news.headline: Tower Bersama (TBIG) issues Rp1.25 trillion of bonds and sukuk to repay UOB loan
top_news.headline_original: Bayar Utang ke Bank UOB, TBIG Terbitkan Obligasi dan Sukuk Rp1,25T
top_news.summary: Tower Bersama Infrastructure (TBIG) will issue Rp1.25 trillion in bonds and sukuk to repay a UOB bank loan.

top_news.headline: Fitch upgrades KBank Indonesia to AA+
top_news.headline_original: Fitch Naikkan Rating KBank Indonesia ke AA+
top_news.summary: Fitch raised the national rating of KBank Indonesia to AA+.

top_news.headline: Weak loan demand leaves idle bank liquidity piling up
top_news.headline_original: Permintaan Kredit Belum Pulih, Kredit Menganggur Perbankan Masih Menumpuk
top_news.summary: Sluggish credit demand has left banks with a growing pool of undeployed liquidity.

corporate.headline: Controlling shareholder adds further to REAL stake
corporate.summary: REAL's controller increased its ownership in the company.

corporate.headline: FUTR president director buys 1% stake worth Rp15.3 billion
corporate.summary: FUTR's CEO purchased a 1% stake in the company worth Rp15.3 billion.

corporate.headline: Property developer BBSS still posts a loss in Q1 2026
corporate.summary: Real-estate issuer BBSS remained loss-making in the first quarter of 2026.

corporate.headline: Elnusa (ELSA) lifts Adera field oil & gas output beyond target
corporate.summary: Elnusa said production at its Adera field exceeded the company's target.

corporate.headline: Taro snack maker (AISA) opens the door to a dividend
corporate.summary: AISA signaled the possibility of distributing a dividend.

corporate.headline: Two banks aim to build a large sharia bank to rival BSI
corporate.summary: Two banks plan to form a larger Islamic bank to compete with market leader BSI.

bank_indonesia.headline: BI-Rate held at 5.75%: strengthening stability, supporting economic growth
bank_indonesia.summary: Bank Indonesia kept the BI-Rate at 5.75% and maintained the Deposit Facility rate.

bank_indonesia.headline: Banking Survey Q2 2026: new loan disbursements increase
bank_indonesia.summary: BI's quarterly banking survey showed new loan disbursements rose in Q2 2026.

bank_indonesia.headline: Prompt Manufacturing Index Q2 2026: manufacturing performance maintained
bank_indonesia.summary: BI's PMI indicated manufacturing-sector performance held up in the second quarter.

bank_indonesia.headline: Business Survey Q2 2026: business activity increased
bank_indonesia.summary: BI's business survey reported an increase in overall business activity in Q2 2026.

bank_indonesia.headline: Indonesia's external debt maintained in May 2026
bank_indonesia.summary: BI reported that Indonesia's external debt remained contained in May 2026.

global.headline: Fed seen holding rates at 3.50–3.75% at July 28–29 FOMC
global.summary: Markets expect the Federal Reserve to keep its target range at 3.50–3.75% at the 28–29 July meeting; no new economic projections are due.

global.headline: US to impose new tariffs on dozens of economies by Friday as stopgap duties lapse
global.summary: The Trump administration is preparing fresh tariffs on many trading partners before temporary 10% global duties expire on 24 July.

global.headline: Dollar index (DXY) little changed near 101.15
global.summary: The US dollar index traded around 101.15, down 0.02%, after a three-session climb as US–Iran tensions lifted oil prices.

global.headline: US 10-year Treasury yield rises above 4.6% to about 4.63%
global.summary: The 10-year Treasury yield climbed roughly 3 basis points to 4.63% amid higher oil prices and inflation concerns.
